scope: Module-level semantic matrix of graphiti_core, mcp_server and server (274 Python files); commerce-useful deterministic semantics absorbed with oracles, the rest classified with reasons. ECDEV does not become a Graphiti clone.

oracle.generator: embedded as generator_source in the fixture; runs the unmodified pinned clone; no tracked file imports graphiti_core
oracle.reproducibility: names, jaccard, invalidations and fusions identical across PYTHONHASHSEED 1-3; resolutions differ only by hash-seeded tie order, recorded as fuzzy_candidates_at_best_score
oracle.note: fusion cases are retained in the frozen fixture but no longer executed: the capability was resolved NOT_RELEVANT

rows.behaviour: exact name normalization, entropy gate, 3-gram MinHash (BLAKE2b-64) with LSH bands, Jaccard>=0.9 candidate resolution, generic-label promotion
rows.proof: PARITY_PROVEN: 130 name cases, 400 Jaccard pairs, 150 resolution scenarios; donor tie order is hash-seeded, ECDEV picks earliest existing candidate
rows.note: proposes candidate links only; ECDEV identity stays assertion-based (resolution.rs)

rows.behaviour: bi-temporal supersession: an earlier-valid fact ends when a newer contradicting fact starts; disjoint windows untouched
rows.proof: PARITY_PROVEN: 600 window combinations including unknown bounds; expired_at is wall-clock bookkeeping set by the caller
rows.note: contradiction detection itself is LLM-judged in the donor and is NOT absorbed

rows.behaviour: reciprocal rank fusion with rank constant and minimum score; stable tie order
rows.proof: PARITY_PROVEN earlier (300 fusion cases, bit-exact) and then withdrawn: no production caller
rows.note: Graphiti's only caller fuses BM25 and vector search result lists (search/search.py hybrid search). ECDEV runs no multi-retriever search and stores no embeddings, so no two rankings exist to fuse. The uncalled native copy was removed; the frozen fusion cases stay in the fixture unchanged so its recorded sha256 and embedded generator remain reproducible.

rows.proof: PARITY_PROVEN earlier (graphiti_timezone_oracle, 901 cases); naive datetimes are rejected by ECDEV rather than assumed UTC

rows.note: ECDEV stores no embeddings and runs no vector search; revisit only if a native embedding store exists

rows.behaviour: community detection by label propagation over entity neighbours
rows.note: label_propagation runs only inside get_community_clusters over RELATES_TO edges between LLM-extracted EntityNodes (community_operations.py:30-90), and its only caller build_communities feeds clusters to LLM community summaries (graphiti.py build_communities). ECDEV excludes LLM extraction, so the entity-neighbour graph it needs never exists; ECDEV social clusters (social.rs::clusters) are evidence-linked term groups over captured posts.

compress_uuid_map closes LLM-judged duplicate edge pairs (bulk_utils.py:540-567, resolve_extracted_edge). ECDEV identity is key equality (resolution.rs::key), which is already an equivalence relation, and uncertain title-similarity links must never be closed transitively: A~B and B~C does not give A~C. Merging them would turn POSSIBLE_EQUIVALENCE into fabricated identity.

rows.behaviour: token-estimate based JSON/text/message chunking for LLM prompts
rows.note: exists to fit LLM context windows; ECDEV extraction is deterministic

rows.source: graphiti_core/utils/maintenance/node_operations.py, edge_operations.py (extract_*, resolve_* with LLM), combined_extraction.py, attribute_utils.py, prompts/
rows.behaviour: LLM entity/edge extraction, attribute extraction, summaries, contradiction judgement, prompt templates
rows.note: LLM-generated facts are not evidence under ECDEV's OBSERVED/DERIVED/ESTIMATED/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT model
zero-paid default; no model provider dependency

rows.behaviour: Neo4j, FalkorDB, Kuzu, Neptune drivers and query builders
rows.note: ECDEV persists evidence in its own SQLite runs; no graph database

rows.behaviour: orchestration facade and persisted node/edge models
rows.note: valid_at/invalid_at/expired_at/created_at bi-temporal fields informed memory::Validity; persistence models not absorbed

rows.behaviour: hosted MCP and REST services over Graphiti
rows.note: ECDEV exposes its own MCP/HTTP server; no Graphiti service dependency
